Extract `adata.raw` as a CsparseMatrix

Source: R/extract_anndata_raw.R
extract_anndata_raw.Rd

`adata.raw` (a snapshot of an AnnData often used by scanpy to retain raw counts after normalisation) is a separate AnnData-like object with its own `.X`, `.var`, and `.var_names`. It may have a different number of features from the main AnnData object.

Usage

extract_anndata_raw(adata, obs_names = NULL)

Arguments

adata

An AnnData object.

obs_names

Character vector of cell names. Optional.

Value

A CsparseMatrix of shape `n_obs x n_raw_vars`, or `NULL`.

Details

This helper returns the raw matrix in AnnData orientation (cells x features), with cell rownames from `obs_names` (the active AnnData) and feature column names from `adata$raw$var_names`. Returns `NULL` if `adata$raw` is unset.
